info.name: Corisio API — Full Platform
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Corisio platform.

Covers: store auth & onboarding, referrals & boosts, public discovery, product visibility engine, engagement tracking, and admin tools.

## Base URL
`{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`

## Authentication
Two token types:
- **Store JWT** (`storeToken`) — for store owners. Set after `POST /stores/auth/verify-otp`.
- **Admin JWT** (`adminToken`) — for Corisio staff. Set after admin login.

## Response Format
All responses:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "type": "success",
  "message": "...",
  "data": { ... },
  "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## Onboarding Flow
1. `POST /stores/auth/send-otp`
2. `POST /stores/auth/verify-otp` → saves `storeToken`
3. `POST /stores/register` → submit profile
4. Admin verifies → boost auto-assigned
5. Store can now list products

## Product Visibility Flow
1. Admin seeds categories/subcategories/product groups (config system)
2. Verified store creates products → `POST /stores/products`
3. Public users discover via `GET /public/products/search`

item.name: 🔐 Store Auth
item.description: OTP-based authentication for store owners. No password needed — phone number + OTP only.

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the provided phone number via SMS (Twilio).

If the phone number has no existing store record, a stub record is created automatically.

**In development mode**, the OTP is returned in the response body for testing.

**Rate limiting:** Max 3 OTP requests per phone per 10 minutes.

**Expected behaviour:**
- New number → creates stub store → sends OTP
- Existing number → resends OTP

**Response includes** (dev only):
```json
{
  "phoneNumber": "+2348012345678",
  "message": "OTP sent successfully",
  "otp": "123456"
}
```

Verifies the OTP and issues a JWT access token + refresh token.

**On success:**
- `isPhoneVerified` set to `true`
- `onboardingStatus` advances to `phone_verified`
- JWT stored in `storeToken` httpOnly cookie AND returned in body

**OTP expiry:** 10 minutes

**Token expiry:** Access token 7 days, Refresh token 30 days

**Next step after this:** Call `POST /stores/register` to complete the profile.

Generates a fresh OTP and sends it to the phone number. Invalidates the previous OTP.

**Use when:** User did not receive the first OTP or it expired.

**Cooldown:** 60 seconds between resend requests (enforced server-side).

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token. Use when the access token expires (7 days).

**Store the refresh token** on the client at initial login and use it here when you get a 401.

**Refresh token validity:** 30 days

Clears the refresh token from the database and expires the auth cookie.

**Frontend should also:** delete the stored token from localStorage/AsyncStorage.

**Requires:** Valid store JWT in Authorization header.

item.name: 🏪 Store Profile & Onboarding
item.description: Store profile setup and management. The minimal required fields for onboarding are: storeName, ownerName, category, address. All others are optional but improve discoverability.

request.description:
Submit the store's profile. **Can also be used as PUT /stores/profile** for updating.

**Required fields (minimum to advance to `profile_complete`):**
- `storeName`
- `ownerName`
- `category` (ObjectId from Categories API)
- `address.raw`, `address.lga`, `address.state`, `address.coordinates`

**Optional fields:**
- `referralCode` — the code of the store that referred this one. Only accepted once, and only from a verified referrer store. Creates a `Referral` record.
- `description` — max 500 chars
- `openingHours` — array of day objects
- `website`

**Status transitions:**
- Before: `phone_verified`
- After (all required fields present): `profile_complete`

**Profile score** is recalculated on every save (0–100).

**Referral handling:** If `referralCode` is provided and the referrer is verified, a `Referral` record is created with `status: pending`. The boost only activates AFTER admin verification.

Update any optional profile fields after registration. Same endpoint as POST /stores/register — partial updates are supported (only send changed fields).

**Note:** `referralCode` (incoming) is ignored if a referral was already set.

Returns the full profile of the currently authenticated store, including boost status, verification status, and referral code.

Use on app launch to restore session state.

response.name: 200 — Store Profile

request.description:
Returns a checklist of profile fields with completion status, point values, and whether the store is ready for admin verification.

**Use this to build the onboarding progress UI.**

`readyForVerification: true` means the store has all required fields (score ≥ 50) and can be submitted to the admin queue.

response.name: 200 — Completion Checklist

  "type": "success",

      { "field": "phoneNumber", "label": "Phone (verified)", "complete": true, "points": 10, "required": true },
      { "field": "category", "label": "Category", "complete": true, "points": 10, "required": true },

formdata.description: Store photo — JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF. Max 5MB.

request.description:
Upload one store photo at a time. Photos are uploaded to Cloudinary and the URL is stored in the `photos` array.

**Constraints:**
- Max file size: 5MB
- Allowed types: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF
- Max photos per store: 5

**Effect:** Adds 15 points to `profileCompletionScore` when first photo is added.

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data` (set automatically by Postman when using file upload).

Public store listing with geo-proximity sorting and optional filters.

**Boost-aware ranking:** Stores with active boosts appear higher in results:
- Gold → top of results
- Silver → above non-boosted
- Bronze → slight priority

**Requires:** No auth. Optionally pass user coordinates for distance-sorted results.

**Results include:** store name, category, address, boost level, distance from user, photos.

Retrieves full public profile for a single store.

Also increments `profileViews` counter for analytics.

**Returns:** All public fields including photos, opening hours, description, boost badge, and address.

Returns the store's own performance metrics.

**Metrics:**
- `profileViews` — total visits to store detail page
- `searchAppearances` — how many times shown in search results
- `clickThroughs` — clicks from search results to profile
- `ctr` — click-through rate (clickThroughs / searchAppearances)
- `validatedReferrals` — count of successfully validated referrals
- `boost` — current boost status

item.name: 🔗 Referral System
item.description: Referral management for store owners. Only VERIFIED stores can generate and send referral links. Referral rewards (boosts) only activate when the referred store completes their profile AND is verified by an admin.

request.description:
Returns the store's unique referral code, shareable link, and QR code URL.

**Requires:** Store must have `onboardingStatus: verified` — pending stores cannot refer others.

**Shareable link format:** `https://corisio.ng/join?ref=STOR-AB12XY`

**QR Code:** Pre-generated URL pointing to a QR code image for print or display.

response.name: 403 — Store Not Verified

request.description:
Sends a referral invitation SMS to a neighbouring store's phone number.

**Rate limit:** Max 5 SMS referrals per store per 24 hours. Returns `429` if exceeded.

**Guard:** If the phone number belongs to an already-verified store, returns `409 Conflict`.

**SMS content example:**
> "Hi! Mama Tee's Kitchen invites you to list your store on Corisio — Abuja's local store directory. Join here: https://corisio.ng/join?ref=STOR-AB12XY"

**Requires:** Verified store only.

response.name: 429 — Daily Limit Reached
409 — Already Registered

request.description:
Lists all stores this store has referred, with their current referral status.

**Status meanings:**
- `pending` — referred store registered but not yet verified
- `profile_complete` — referred store submitted full profile, awaiting admin review
- `validated` — referred store verified by admin → boost has been applied
- `rejected` — referral flagged or failed abuse check

**Use this to build the referral tracking screen in the app.**

response.name: 200 — My Referrals List

request.description:
Returns the store's referral performance summary and progress toward the next boost level.

**Boost milestones:**
| Level | Required Referrals | Duration |
|-------|-------------------|----------|
| Bronze | 1 | 30 days |
| Silver | 4 | 60 days |
| Gold | 10 | 90 days |

**Progress object** tells the frontend:
- Current boost level
- Next level to aim for
- How many more validated referrals needed

**Use this to build the boost progress bar/gamification UI.**

response.name: 200 — Stats + Progress

request.description:
Returns the store's current boost level, active/inactive state, and days remaining.

**Use this for the boost badge/banner in the store dashboard.**

**`isActive`** is `true` only if boost level is not `none` AND `expiresAt` is in the future.

item.name: 🔍 Public Discovery
item.description: No authentication required. These endpoints power the public-facing app — store discovery, store profiles, and product search.

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/public/stores?lat=('9.0765', 'User latitude (decimal degrees)')&lng=('7.3986', 'User longitude (decimal degrees)')&radius=('5', 'Search radius in km (default: 5)')&search=('', 'Full-text search on storeName / description')&category=('', 'Category ObjectId to filter by')&sortBy=('boost', 'boost | distance | newest')&boostedOnly=('false', 'true to show only boosted stores')&page=('1', 'Page number')&limit=('20', 'Results per page (max 50)')

query.description: true to show only boosted stores

request.description:
Find verified stores near a location. Results are ranked by boost level + distance + recency.

**All params optional.** If lat/lng omitted, returns all verified stores sorted by boost.

**Sort options:** `boost` (default), `distance`, `newest`

Returns full public profile for a single verified store. Increments `profileViews` counter on the store.

Returns 404 if store is not verified, suspended, or deleted.

Fire-and-forget. Call when a user opens a store's full profile page.

Returns immediately (<5ms). Write happens asynchronously.

**No body required.**

Fire-and-forget. Call when a user taps a store card in the discovery list.

Also increments `clickThroughs` on the Store document.
Fire-and-forget. Call when a user taps the call/phone button on a store profile.
Fire-and-forget. Call when a user taps the 'Get Directions' button on a store profile.

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/public/products/search?query=('', 'Full-text search on product label / description / tags')&category=('', 'Category ObjectId')&sub_category=('', 'SubCategory ObjectId')&product_group=('', 'ProductGroup ObjectId')&condition=('new', 'new | used | refurbished')&availability=('in_stock', 'in_stock | out_of_stock | on_order')&minPrice=('', 'Minimum price (NGN)')&maxPrice=('', 'Maximum price (NGN)')&tags=('', 'Comma-separated tags, e.g. halal,bulk')&lat=('9.0765', 'User latitude')&lng=('7.3986', 'User longitude')&radius=('5', 'Search radius in km (default: 5)')&sortBy=('relevance', 'relevance | price_asc | price_desc | newest | distance')&page=('1', 'Page number')&limit=('20', 'Results per page (max 50)')

query.description: Full-text search on product label / description / tags

request.description:
Search products across all verified stores.

Products from unverified or suspended stores are automatically excluded.

**Geo filter:** Provide `lat`, `lng`, `radius` to filter products by store proximity.

**Sort options:**
- `relevance` (default) — boosted stores first, then distance
- `price_asc` / `price_desc`
- `newest`
- `distance` (requires lat/lng)

**Tags:** comma-separated string, e.g. `tags=halal,bulk`

response.name: 200 — Products Found

request.description:
Returns full public product detail with store context.

Increments `viewCount` on the product (fire-and-forget).

Returns 404 if product is inactive or its store is unverified.

response.name: 200 — Product

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/public/stores/{{storeId}}/products?category=('', 'Filter by category ObjectId')&page=('1', 'Page number')&limit=('20', 'Results per page (max 50)')

request.description:
Lists active, in-stock products for a specific verified store.

Used on the store's public profile page as a product listing widget.

item.name: 📦 Store — Product Management
item.description:
Store owner endpoints for managing product listings. All routes require a verified store JWT.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{storeToken}}`

**Product cap:** 50 active products per store (configurable via `MAX_PRODUCTS_PER_STORE` env var).

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/stores/products?isActive=('true', 'true | false — filter by active status')&category=('', 'Filter by Category ObjectId')&sub_category=('', 'Filter by SubCategory ObjectId')&availability=('', 'in_stock | out_of_stock | on_order')&search=('', 'Search in product label')&page=('1', 'Page number')&limit=('20', 'Results per page (max 50)')

query.description: true | false — filter by active status

request.description:
Returns all products for the authenticated store, including inactive ones.

Use `isActive=true` to see only live listings.

Returns full product detail for a product owned by the authenticated store.

Includes private fields like `viewCount`, `searchAppearances`, `boostLevel`.

Creates a new product listing for the authenticated store.

**Required fields:** `label`, `price`, `images` (min 1), `category`, `sub_category`, `specifications`

**Optional:** `product_group`, `description`, `video`, `tags`, `condition`, `availability`, `totalInStock`

**Limits:**
- Max 50 active products per store
- Max 10 tags
- Images must be valid URLs

{
  "label": "Indomie Noodles Chicken 70g",
  "description": "Classic chicken flavour instant noodles",
  "price": 350,
  "currency": "NGN",
  "availability": "in_stock",
  "totalInStock": 200,
  "condition": "new",
  "images": [
    "https://cdn.example.com/indomie-chicken.jpg"
  ],
  "video": "",

    "weight": "70g",

  },

response.name: 400 — Validation Error
429 — Product Cap Reached
response.body: {"success": false, "type": "error", "message": "Store has reached the maximum of 50 active products", "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}

request.description:
Full or partial update of a product. Only the authenticated store's own products can be updated.

All fields are optional — send only what you want to change.

If `availability` is changed, `inStock` is automatically synced.

Lightweight endpoint to change just the availability status.

Use this for quick stock toggles from mobile — avoids sending the full product payload.

Automatic sync: changing `availability` also updates the `inStock` boolean.

response.name: 400 — Invalid Value

request.description:
Soft-deletes the product by setting `isActive = false`.

The product is removed from all public search results immediately.

**Data is preserved** for analytics — product record is never hard-deleted.

Only the owning store can delete their products.

item.name: 🛡️ Admin — Store Verification
item.description: Admin endpoints for verifying stores, managing the verification queue, and manually granting boosts. All routes require a valid admin JWT with appropriate permissions.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of stores with `onboardingStatus: profile_complete` — i.e. stores waiting for admin verification.

**Sorted:** Oldest first (FIFO queue — longest waiting stores appear first).

**Filters:** `lga`, `category`

**Permission required:** `view_users`

**Includes:** Category name, referral info (who referred this store).

response.name: 200 — Pending Queue

request.description:
Full admin view of a store including:
- Complete store data
- Referral history (all referrals this store has made)
- Referral received (who referred this store)
- Boost history (full ledger)

**Permission required:** `view_users`

Marks a store as verified. **This is the most important action in the system** — it triggers the entire referral validation chain.

**What happens automatically after this call:**
1. `onboardingStatus` → `verified`
2. `verifiedAt`, `verifiedBy`, `verificationMethod` recorded
3. `validateReferral()` service called asynchronously
4. If referral passes abuse checks → `Referral.status` → `validated`
5. Referrer's `boost` level recalculated and updated
6. `BoostLedger` entry created (immutable audit)
7. Push notification sent to referrer store owner

**Verification methods:**
- `agent_visit` — field agent physically visited the store
- `gps` — GPS coordinates confirmed
- `photo` — store photo verified
- `id_check` — owner ID checked

**`verifiedCoordinates`** (optional) — agent-confirmed GPS coordinates, updates the store's stored location if provided.

**Permission required:** `create_users`

Rejects a store's verification request with a mandatory reason.

**After rejection:**
- `onboardingStatus` → `rejected`
- `rejectionReason` stored (shown to store owner)
- Store can resubmit corrected info and re-enter verification queue
- Any pending referral is NOT invalidated — it stays `pending` until the store re-applies and is eventually verified or permanently rejected

**Permission required:** `create_users`

Manually grant a boost to a store outside of the normal referral system.

**Use cases:**
- Early adopter promotions
- Make-good for service issues
- Partnership deals

**`level`:** `bronze`, `silver`, or `gold`
**`durationDays`:** How many days the boost lasts (default 30)
**`note`:** Reason for grant (stored in BoostLedger for audit)

**Source** is recorded as `admin_grant` in the boost record.

**Permission required:** `manage_roles`

Returns a 2-level deep referral network tree rooted at the given store.

**Returns:**
- `root` — the store itself
- `directReferrals` — stores directly referred (depth 1)
- `secondDegreeReferrals` — stores referred by direct referrals (depth 2)
- `totalNetwork` — total network size

**Use for:** Admin dashboard network visualization, fraud investigation, understanding store clusters.

**Permission required:** `view_users`

response.name: 200 — Referral Tree

item.name: 🛡️ Admin — Referral Management
item.description: Admin tools for managing referrals, fraud detection, and boost monitoring.

request.description:
Paginated list of all referrals in the system with filtering.

**Filters:**
- `status` — `pending`, `profile_complete`, `validated`, `rejected`
- `flagged` — `true` to see only fraud-flagged referrals

**Permission required:** `view_users`

Flags a referral as fraudulent.

**If the referral was already `validated`:**
- Status reverted to `rejected`
- Referrer's boost is recalculated (this referral no longer counts)
- `BoostLedger` records the change

**If referral was `pending`:**
- Marked as flagged — will not validate even if store is later verified

**Permission required:** `manage_roles`

Clears the fraud flag from a referral after manual review determines it is legitimate.

**Note:** Unflagging does NOT automatically re-validate the referral or re-apply the boost. Admin should re-run verification flow or manually grant boost if needed.

**Permission required:** `manage_roles`

Returns all stores whose boosts expire within the next 7 days.

**Use case:** Proactively notify stores to refer more stores before their boost expires. Good for automated email/push campaign triggers.

**Permission required:** `view_users`

response.name: 200 — Expiring Boosts

request.description:
Returns the complete, immutable boost audit trail for a specific store.

**Every boost event is logged:** activation, upgrade, expiry, revocation, admin grants.

**Each entry includes:**
- `event` — what happened
- `fromLevel` / `toLevel` — the transition
- `triggerReferral` — which referral caused this (if applicable)
- `expiresAt` — when this boost was set to expire
- `note` — admin comment or system note

**Use for:** Dispute resolution, auditing, customer support.

**Permission required:** `access_reports`

response.name: 200 — Boost Ledger

item.name: 📊 Admin — Analytics
item.description: Analytics and reporting endpoints. All require admin JWT with `access_reports` permission.

request.description:
Comprehensive referral network analytics dashboard data.

**Includes:**
- Volume: total, validated, pending, rejected referrals
- Conversion rate (validated / total)
- Top 10 referrers by validated count with boost levels
- Boost distribution across all stores (none/bronze/silver/gold counts)
- Channel breakdown (sms/link/phone_input/qr_code)
- Abuse metrics: flagged count, auto-rejected, pending admin review

**Use for:** Weekly KPI reporting, identifying top referrers for rewards, detecting abuse spikes.

response.name: 200 — Full Analytics

query.description: Number of days to look back (default: 30)

request.description:
Store onboarding conversion funnel for a given time period.

**Funnel stages:**
1. `registered` — phone number submitted
2. `phoneVerified` — OTP verified
3. `profileComplete` — all required fields submitted
4. `verified` — admin approved
5. `rejected` — admin rejected

**Drop-off rates** calculated between each stage to identify friction points.

**`avgOnboardingMinutes`** — average time from registration to profile_complete.

**Use for:** Identifying where stores drop off, optimizing the onboarding UX.

Returns store density data grouped by LGA and category — ideal for rendering a geo heatmap or coverage map.

**Returns:**
- `clusters` — array of { lga, category, count, centroid [lng, lat] }
- `lgaSummary` — stores per LGA sorted by density
- `densestLGA` — the most store-dense LGA
- `coverageZones` — number of unique LGAs with verified stores

**Use for:**
- Identifying underserved areas to target for agent outreach
- Map visualization of Corisio store coverage
- Deciding where to focus onboarding campaigns

**Permission required:** `access_reports`

response.name: 200 — Density Data

item.name: 📊 Admin — Engagement Analytics
item.description:
Store and platform engagement analytics — profile views, listing clicks, call clicks, direction clicks tracked in daily buckets.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}`
**Permission required:** `access_reports`

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/admin/analytics/engagement/{{storeId}}?startDate=('2025-01-01', 'Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days ago)')&endDate=('2025-01-31', 'End date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)')

request.description:
Returns engagement data for a single store within a date range.

Includes daily breakdown, period totals, and lifetime totals from the Store document.

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/admin/analytics/engagement?startDate=('2025-01-01', 'Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days ago)')&endDate=('2025-01-31', 'End date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)')

request.description:
Platform-wide engagement totals across all stores for a date range.

Includes conversion rates: call conversion = callClicks / listingClicks.

item.name: 🛡️ Admin — Product Management
item.description:
Admin endpoints for monitoring and moderating product listings across all stores.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}`
**Permission required:** `manage_config`

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/admin/products?storeId=('', 'Filter by store ObjectId')&category=('', 'Filter by Category ObjectId')&sub_category=('', 'Filter by SubCategory ObjectId')&product_group=('', 'Filter by ProductGroup ObjectId')&isActive=('', 'true | false')&availability=('', 'in_stock | out_of_stock | on_order')&condition=('', 'new | used | refurbished')&search=('', 'Search in product label')&page=('1', 'Page number')&limit=('20', 'Results per page (max 100)')

request.description:
Lists all products across all stores with full details including store info.

**Filters:** storeId, category, sub_category, product_group, isActive, availability, condition, search

Platform-wide product statistics: totals by status, availability, condition, and top categories.

Useful for the admin dashboard.

Full product detail including all private fields: viewCount, searchAppearances, boostLevel, and store info.

Includes the ProductGroup's linked spec template.

response.name: 200 — Product Detail

request.description:
Toggles a product's `isActive` field.

- `true → false`: product disappears from all public search results
- `false → true`: product reappears if the store is still verified

**No body required.**
